mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior three months compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, the Federal Reserve is perceived as in a tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and housing starts (HOUST < 2000) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% yoy, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the prior three months signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases over the prior three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 2000 thousand units, it indicates a weakening housing market, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is below 2000, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a tightening monetary policy coinciding with labor market deterioration, reducing corporate profitability and investor risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market stress
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017=100), it indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, reducing corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
